Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the confirmed information that John, Count Palatine of Neumarkt was the son of Rupert III of the Palatinate and erroneously concluded that John the Fearless, Duke of Burgundy, was the father-in-law. This conflated unrelated individuals and ignored the correct evidence, leading to the wrong final answer; the correct father-in-law is Rupert (Rupert III).
